name: Engineer
ability: Once per game, at night, choose which Minions or which Demon is in play.
designRole: One opportunity to choose which Minions or Demon are in play, changing the mechanical world.
explanation: One opportunity to choose which Minions or Demon are in play, changing the mechanical world.

nightInstructions.firstNight: The Engineer might choose Minions or Demons. Put the Engineer to sleep. Wake the target(s) one at a time. Show the *YOU ARE* info token & their new character token. :reminder:
nightInstructions.otherNights: The Engineer might choose Minions or Demons. Put the Engineer to sleep. Wake the target(s) one at a time. Show the *YOU ARE* info token & their new character token. :reminder:

jinxes.reason: If Legion is created, all evil players become Legion. If Legion is in play, the Engineer starts knowing this but has no ability.
If the living Summoner is removed from play, the Storyteller has the Summoner ability.
